title: GitHub Copilot: from zero to hero
intro: A practical course that takes you from your first Copilot suggestion to running AI-assisted engineering across a team. It focuses on real engineering workflows rather than feature lists: how Copilot works, how to steer it, how to validate what it produces, and how to scale it with instructions, agents, MCP and specs.

levels.name: Start here
levels.summary: How the course works, how Copilot is changing engineering work, and the rules for using it well.

levels.name: Team practice
levels.summary: Shaping Copilot for a team: instructions, agents and repositories that AI can work with.

levels.name: Scale
levels.summary: Orchestration and delivery at scale: MCP, spec-driven development and the AI-SDLC operating model.
